Full Stack Engineer (React + Node / Python)
Groww
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)

About Groww:
Groww is a fast-growing financial services platform making investing simple for millions.

Responsibilities:
• Develop intuitive user interfaces in React.js and Next.js.
• Build scalable backend REST APIs using Node.js or Python.
• Integrate relational databases (PostgreSQL) and caching systems (Redis).
• Write unit tests and maintain CI/CD pipelines on AWS.

Requirements:
• 1-3 years of software engineering experience.
• Hands-on expertise in React, JavaScript, Node.js, Python, and SQL.
• B.Tech in Computer Science or related degree.
